changelog:
Initial release – interactively manage Alibaba Cloud DTS data migration and synchronization tasks.

- Create, list, and manage DTS migration or sync tasks through guided workflows.
- View detailed task status, including progress and delay, for any DTS task.
- Start, stop, suspend, resume, and release (delete) specific tasks with confirmations.
- Includes robust handling of edge cases: ambiguous IDs, case inconsistencies, forced deletions, and auto-cleanup on errors.
- Ensures all sensitive information (e.g., passwords) is never displayed or echoed in plaintext.
- All operations automatically triggered based on relevant user keywords.
